question: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmented into ten evenly divided tiers based on their December 2021 sales profits?
sql:
WITH customer_profits AS (
  SELECT s.cust_id, SUM(s.amount_sold - (c.unit_cost * s.quantity_sold)) AS total_profit
  FROM sales s
  JOIN costs c ON s.prod_id = c.prod_id AND s.time_id = c.time_id AND s.channel_id = c.channel_id AND s.promo_id = c.promo_id
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND s.time_id IN (SELECT time_id FROM times WHERE calendar_year = 2021 AND calendar_month_name = 'December')
  GROUP BY s.cust_id
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT cust_id, total_profit,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS profit_tier
  FROM customer_profits
)
SELECT profit_tier, ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) AS lowest_profit, ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) AS highest_profit
FROM tiered
GROUP BY profit_tier
ORDER BY profit_tier

  FROM sales s
  JOIN costs c ON s.prod_id = c.prod_id AND s.time_id = c.time_id AND s.channel_id = c.channel_id AND s.promo_id = c.promo_id
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND s.time_id IN (SELECT time_id FROM times WHERE calendar_year = 2021 AND calendar_month_name = 'December')
  GROUP BY s.cust_id
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT cust_id, total_profit,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS profit_tier
  FROM customer_profits

SELECT profit_tier, ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) AS lowest_profit, ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) AS highest_profit
FROM tiered
GROUP BY profit_tier
